reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:150-162, `santizeAnchors` only iterates over `matcher.find()` on the translated `value` and never checks after the loop whether `englishMatcher.find()` still has unmatched anchor tags from `englishValue`. As a result, a translation that drops one or all anchor tags present in the English source records no error in `messages` and passes `verifySafeHtml()`.
